oracle.name: Avengers Assemble!
oracle.oracle_text:
Flash
Heroes you control get +2/+2.
At the beginning of each end step, if you attacked with a Hero this turn or a Hero entered the battlefield under your control this turn, draw a card.

oracle.name: Iron Man, Master of Machines
oracle.oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
Iron Man gets +1/+0 for each other artifact you control.
Whenever Iron Man attacks, if an artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn, draw a card.

Iron Man, Master of Machines: Pay 2UR; legendary artifact creature Human Hero1/4; flying and vigilance.
Live layer7c +1/+0 per OTHER artifact YOU currently control, including artifact lands, noncreatures and tokens. Exclude exact self, use effective artifact kind/current controller.
Whenever exact source attacks, intervening-if an artifact entered under captured trigger controller this turn: draw one for that captured controller.
Self-entry counts as an artifact entry, so haste can allow same-turn trigger; older source cannot manufacture a fresh entry next turn.
Artifact need not survive, remain artifact or remain controlled; source can leave/change control after queued ability. No trigger if condition false at event, even if it later becomes true.
Avengers Assemble!: Pay4W; enchantment with flash, legal instant-speed casting through existing priority/permission rules.
Heroes YOU control get live+2/+2; implement existing Hero CreatureFilter static modifier at Modify layer, not counters or dynamic base-setting.
At beginning of EACH end step, intervening-if your Hero attack OR Hero entry happened this turn: draw one. Both conditions true still one trigger per source.
Facts record before Avengers exists, including earlier Hero dying, type change, control transfer or blink. Multiple Avengers produce independent triggers.
Hero-entry condition includes noncreature Kindred Hero characteristics; Hero attack requires actually declaring an attacker, not merely entering attacking.

Current controller at step event chooses whose turn history; queued draw and guard use captured controller after source removal/control transfer. Reset both players history at new turn, including opponent-turn flash entry.

authoritative_sources.summary: Iron Man requires an earlier artifact entry when he attacks. Later artifact entry cannot create a missed trigger. Avengers checks at each end-step beginning; a later Hero entry cannot create that missed trigger. Relevant earlier permanents need not remain on the battlefield or under the same control.

Declaration tapping precedes becoming an attacker and attack triggers; later characteristic changes do not retroactively trigger an attack. Permanents have continuous modifications immediately on entry. Intervening-if conditions are checked when triggering and resolving.

java_discrepancy_and_limits: ArtifactEnteredControllerWatcher captures effective artifact/controller at entry, useful evidence for immutable flags; watcher registration must not restrict Rust recording to battlefield source presence.

AttackedThisTurnWatcher retains Permanent references rather than explicitly copying them; do not adopt mutable live-object history. Event-time effective subtype/controller must be frozen from primary declaration rules. Exact Java mutation consequences are not newly certified here.

PermanentsEnteredBattlefieldWatcher copies Permanent at entry, but Avengers later calls hasSubtype(...,game); Rust must not reevaluate a mutable historical object under later continuous effects. Use frozen fact.

Avengers static Java creature filter and unrestricted Hero entry history are intentionally distinct. Do not substitute live AttackingSubtype, generic Attacked bool or NonlandEntriesThisTurn for any filtered fact.
shared_mechanics: Three inline per-player turn facts record actual effective artifact/Hero entries only after the whole final entry batch, providers, controllers and attachments are installed, before observers. Zero/prevented entry does not count. Facts survive later type/control/zone changes and are recorded even before an observer exists.
Hero attack history samples actual declared attackers after declaration taps/costs, at the attack-trigger event (CR508.1f/k/m). Put-attacking does not count. Both players reset each new turn.
Typed history guards use captured trigger controller and existing intervening-if queue/resolution checks. Captured packets retain public visibility after source departure/control change.

Existing additive7c scaling counts OTHER current artifacts, including lands/tokens, and shares actual/funding characteristics. Existing Hero CREATURE lord, Flash, flying, vigilance and draw semantics reused.
